bandMeaning.low: Asks for little and can be verified well.
bandMeaning.medium: Can run web pages or reach the internet, or is hard to verify.
bandMeaning.high: Many powerful permissions, or poorly verifiable. Needs an extra confirmation to install.

chipLabel: Security score {{score}} out of 100. {{band}}. Higher means more risk.
inline: Score {{score}} of 100 · higher means more risk · calculated from the verified package
title: Security score
officialNoScore: Official plugins do not get a score: the review is the stronger check, and a number next to it would suggest they can be compared.
browseNote: Scores are shown for unofficial plugins only. Official plugins are reviewed by Mumcord instead.
browseFootnote: Security scores are estimates worked out on your computer from what a plugin asks for and who published it. They are not a guarantee.
developerNote: Developer plugins are scored for information only. Nothing is blocked.
explain: The score looks at what this plugin is able to do, how much Mumcord can verify about its author, and how its permissions changed over time. It does not read the plugin's code or the websites it talks to.
honesty: This score is an estimate, not a guarantee. A low score does not make a plugin safe, and a high score does not mean it is harmful. Calculated on this computer, with the same result every time, using the open formula.
honestyShort: This score is an estimate worked out on your computer from what a plugin asks for and who published it. It is not a guarantee.
notReviewedText: This plugin comes from the third-party repository “{{repository}}”. Mumcord checks that it is unchanged, but nobody at Mumcord has looked at what it does.

legend.title: All score labels
legend.label: Label
legend.colourNote: Every label has a colour, an icon and words, so it still works in greyscale and for people who can't tell red from green. The number is always followed by “higher means more risk” for screen readers.

blocked.settingReason: Install is disabled because “Don't allow high-risk plugins” is on.

hardStop.title: Cannot be installed
hardStop.insecureOrigin: Cannot be installed: it wants to use a website that is not encrypted.
hardStop.bareIp: Cannot be installed: it wants to use a website given as an IP address.
hardStop.wildcard: Cannot be installed: it wants to use a whole group of websites (a wildcard).
hardStop.userInfo: Cannot be installed: a website address contains a user name or password.
hardStop.localName: Cannot be installed: it wants to use a website on your own computer or network.
hardStop.tooManyOrigins: Cannot be installed: it wants to use more than {{count}} websites.
hardStop.badSignature: Cannot be installed: its signature is not valid.
hardStop.hashMismatch: Cannot be installed: the download does not match the signed list.
hardStop.manifestMismatch: Cannot be installed: its description does not match the signed list.
hardStop.revoked: Cannot be installed: Mumcord has withdrawn this plugin.
hardStop.noScore: No score is shown; the reason is.

higherThanListing: This plugin scores higher than its listing said

safety.title: Plugin safety
safety.label: Don't allow high-risk plugins
safety.description: Hides the Install button for plugins with a score of 60 or more, and stops updates that would push an installed plugin there. Plugins you already installed keep working.
safety.note: Off by default. Official plugins and developer plugins are never affected. Scores are estimates, not a guarantee.
safety.highConfirmed: High risk: you confirmed this on {{date}}.

update.upText_one: The risk goes up by {{count}} points
update.upText_many: The risk goes up by {{count}} points
update.upText_other: The risk goes up by {{count}} points
update.because: because this version asks for more:
update.recentChange: It also counts as a recent change: new permissions in the last {{versions}} versions add another +{{history}} points. Together with the +{{added}} above (× {{factor}}) that is the +{{total}}.
update.heldRiskUp: Not installed automatically: the risk went up from {{from}} to {{to}}. Review it first.
update.waitingNote: Automatic updates only install when the plugin asks for nothing new and its score stays in the same band or goes down. Everything else waits here.
